title: The Pangolin of Pelting Plates
story: Vraxonel curled across the only rope bridge out of Thunder Canyon, sealed under 96 clanging stone plates, and the goat-herders couldn't get their flock home. Mr 6 found he could pry loose 11 plates every minute with the flat of his sword — but the beast's magic grew 5 new plates back each minute too. 'Count before you climb,' Mr 6 said, chalking numbers on the cliff.
question: If Mr 6 pries off 11 plates each minute while 5 plates grow back each minute, how many minutes until all 96 plates are gone?
solution: Each minute the armor really shrinks by 11 - 5 = 6 plates.
All 96 plates are gone after 16 minutes.
praise: Dividing was exactly the right instinct — the missing step was subtracting the 5 plates that grow back before you divide.
hint: Don't divide by 11 yet — first work out the NET change in plates during one whole minute.
victory: On the sixteenth minute the last plate pinged off, and Vraxonel — suddenly soft, pink and embarrassed — rolled away down the canyon like a shy boulder. The goats crossed the bridge in a tidy line, unimpressed.
imagePrompt: A huge armored pangolin curled across a swaying rope bridge in a storm-lit canyon while a brave numeral-six knight in a blue cape chalks tally marks on the cliff face, stone plates clattering into the mist below.
